A few years ago, my puppy got a tick in his ear. The one in Dél-Pesti was the closest. They were so kind to Szutyi that we always went there from then on. Then Szutyi chose a doctor for herself (I've never seen anything like this: the Doctor vaccinated her, shaved her legs, took blood from her, and then at the end of the whole adventure, Szutyi invited her to play; the blood test praises the Doctor's thoroughness, she didn't have a large laboratory before.) The registration has improved in recent years, I really like the online option. Especially the fact that the time available for the patient depends on the description of the problem, so everyone gets the necessary time. It's good that the results of the lab tests are sent online, and the doctor gives the evaluation over the phone. You can buy the necessary medications. There are X-rays and ultrasounds, so you don't have to go to the animal hospital if you don't have to. They don't forget about the owners in the waiting room either.
